ATTACKS THAT HELD (passing tests = evidence; same commands as above):
Edge — E4 replay of an already-settled shot id under a NEW permit is refused before any RPC / does not consume the new permit; E5 byte-identical replay after policy withdrawal or release-authority outage returns the stored receipt without a second RPC (no second charge) and an authority outage is a retryable 503 (not permanent); E7 finalize refuses scored/partial/expired/free_limit_exceeded/junk outcomes with 400 and touches no permit; a settled permit cannot be re-finalized (no resurrection); E8 idempotent reserve replay resolving to a SETTLED permit is returned with its real status (never relabelled reserved), paywall (free_limit) and ineligible authority reserve nothing; E9 a stored receipt whose bytes no longer hash to their digest makes the replay a retryable shot.write_failed — never a second settlement, never an acknowledgement (corrupt state never fabricated into success); E10 parser: partial+null score reaches the RPC as non-chargeable partial, partial WITH a score / scored WITHOUT a score / scored without a permit id are refused before any RPC; E11 premium still needs the release authority and a permit id (no premium bypass of the permit boundary); also E-parser: resultKind values outside scored|low_confidence|partial are 400.
Postgres — P1 offline allocation vs consumption: reserving an offline ticket holds allowance without consuming a rating, a returned unused ticket stays HELD (not re-credited, no new reservation admitted — matches the SQL contract that a disconnected device's allocation is never auto-reclaimed), online consumption counts exactly once; authenticated direct INSERT into analysis_permits is denied (42501); P2 partial is terminal: a released/partial permit refuses a later scored shot and a same-id replay flipped to scored, row and count untouched; P3 late sync onto EXPIRED reservations settles scored→finalized/scored, partial/low_confidence→released, each WITHOUT rewriting created_at, and a consumed expired permit stays consumed; P4 premium row past expires_at is NOT premium (third rating paywalled, permit closed), a live premium row admits it; P5 a shot naming another account's session or a missing session is shot.session_not_found with no row and the permit still reserved (HOLD), the corrected retry settles; P6 malformed result kinds (SCORED/abstained/''/null/number) fail typed with no row, permit still reserved, nothing counted; P7 forged receipts (other owner's id, other permit, flipped result kind, scored receipt without policy lineage, digest mismatch, sha256:null, missing canonical) are shot.receipt_invalid before any write, the matching receipt settles once and a replay under a different receipt is a mismatch; P8 account switch: an id already settled by account B is shot.id_conflict for A, A's permit stays reserved and unspent, B's row byte-identical; P9 one shot id on both channels (online then offline ticket, offline then online with permit) consumes at most one rating each way.
Mobile — M2 per-row access.release_not_authorized / access.paywall_required / access.permit_not_reserved repeated past OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS(8): row never deleted, never receipted, full payload intact, excluded from the batch only once exhausted (HOLD on device — but see P2 break E3: no recovery path); M3 whole-batch 503 repeated 24× burns 0 attempts, first 200 settles exactly once, a relaunch-style second drain sends nothing (no double settlement); M4 mixed batch: refused row does not poison the accepted sibling, keeps every byte, no repair_reason. Existing suites already pin low-confidence release, missing media/permissions, malformed reserve/ack responses, repeated actions and process-death journal recovery (attack4RunCaptureAnalysisPermits, serverResponseMatrix.outbox D1–D9, sync tests) and all 6406 pass on this head.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE on Linux (no verdict given): (a) the real on-device pipeline (Apple Vision pose extraction feeding runCaptureAnalysis) producing/not producing a benchmark output — a Mac/device run needs `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` on the M4 runner (coordinator-owned; NOT run here) plus a simulator capture through apps/mobile/ios; (b) StoreKit sandbox purchase → RevenueCat entitlement → premium permit reservation end to end (`xcodebuild test -workspace apps/mobile/ios/PickleSensei.xcworkspace -scheme PickleSensei -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16'` with a Sandbox Apple Account and the production RC key); (c) real Supabase Auth JWT + production project behaviour of apply_synced_shot (must NOT be run against ucqnaiwqwjtgvlduiuib; only a staging project with the same migrations). Nothing in this report is inferred from those.

Notes for the coordinator: E1 and M1 are the same invariant from two planes — on this head neither the mobile pipeline nor the Edge sync carries or checks a validated benchmark output before `resultKind='scored'` is settled as a credit; the shared decideChargeability() contract exists but is not wired into the charge path (INFERRED from reading index.ts ~L2286–2455 and runCaptureAnalysis.ts; VERIFIED by the two failing tests).
